frame.name: Area Denial Frame

origins.name: Dream Work

origins.name: Suros Synergy

perks.name: Proximity Grenades
perks.description: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

enhanced.name: Proximity Grenades
enhanced.description: Grenades fired from this weapon have increased proximity detection but a decreased blast radius.

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.description: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.

enhanced.name: Blast Distributor
enhanced.description: Dealing splash damage grants an improved bonus to Grenade stat.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Recycled Energy
perks.description: Reloading after defeating targets grants energy to your lowest charged ability.

enhanced.name: Recycled Energy
enhanced.description: Reloading after defeating targets grants an increased amount of energy to your lowest charged ability.

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

enhanced.name: Transcendent Moment
enhanced.description: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant improved stability and handling. Dark elements grant improved range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

enhanced.name: Envious Arsenal
enhanced.description: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves. Increases ammo generation.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.name: Slice
perks.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

enhanced.name: Slice
enhanced.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for an improved duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Binary Orbit
enhanced.description: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for an improved duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

enhanced.name: Frenzy
enhanced.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon for an improved duration until you are out of combat.

perks.name: One for All
perks.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

enhanced.name: One for All
enhanced.description: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

enhanced.name: Attrition Orbs
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage creates a slightly improved Orb of Power.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.
